papers.title: Coefficient of Thermal Expansion of AlSi10Mg, 316L Stainless Steel and Ti6Al4V Alloys Made with Laser Powder Bed Fusion
papers.abstract: This study investigates the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) behavior of LPBF-fabricated AlSi10Mg, 316L stainless steel, and Ti-6Al-4V alloys, focusing on the influence of laser power, scanning speed, and annealing. AlSi10Mg exhibits the highest CTE, but its thermal expansion is highly sensitive to porosity and balling defects. 316L stainless steel shows moderate and stable CTE values, with minimal changes after annealing due to its dense microstructure. Ti-6Al-4V has the lowest CTE, with annealing improving expansion. Higher laser power (100 W) improves fusion, reduces porosity, and stabilizes CTE, while lower power (50 W) increases defects, particularly in AlSi10Mg and Ti-6Al-4V. Scanning speed significantly influences porosity, with 0.4 m/s providing an optimal balance between melt efficiency and defect minimization. Annealing enhances CTE uniformity by reducing the lack of fusion defects and refining grain structures, with the greatest improvements seen in low-laser-energy conditions. These findings provide valuable insights for optimizing LPBF parameters to enhance thermal stability and reliability in aerospace, biomedical, and structural applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V的退火对热膨胀系数的影响，但未涉及疲劳或力学性能，与后处理控制方向的核心需求不符。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate any mechanical performance (fatigue, tensile) of Ti-6Al-4V post-processing; it focuses solely on coefficient of thermal expansion, which is a thermal property.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光粉末床熔融制造的Ti-6Al-4V等合金的热膨胀系数影响因素。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率、扫描速度和退火处理，测量热膨胀系数。
summary_zh.result: Ti-6Al-4V热膨胀系数最低，退火可改善膨胀均匀性。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量不同参数下的热膨胀系数。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) behavior of LPBF-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V, AlSi10Mg, and 316L alloys under varying laser parameters and annealing.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurement of CTE using dilatometry on specimens fabricated with different laser powers, scanning speeds, and annealing conditions.
summary_en.result: Ti-6Al-4V exhibited the lowest CTE, and annealing improved CTE uniformity by reducing defects.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of CTE via dilatometry on LPBF specimens.

papers.title: Machine Learning application in predicting the properties of Ti-6Al-4V samples produced with Power Bed Fusion technology
papers.abstract: In the context of Additive Manufacturing (AM) with high-cost materials such as Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64), minimizing physical experimentation through predictive models offers a strategic advantage in reducing lead time and manufacturing costs. In view of this, the present study attempts to build a systematic framework to establish such a predictive compacity. In particular, eight supervised Machine Learning (ML) models are compared based on their performance in predicting critical physical properties of AM components, i.e., 3D surface roughness, relative density, and hardness. The curated dataset comprises both traditional dimensional printing parameters and dimensionless parameters. Specifically, in addition to the conventional Volumetric Energy Density (VED) and four primary printing parameters (laser power, hatching distance, scanning speed, and layer height), the study discusses two dimensionless numbers Π 1 and Π 2 for property prediction. This work underscores the role of selecting predictors and models in advancing data-driven process optimization, offering a scalable approach for reducing experimental overhead in metal AM. • Proposes a predictive modeling framework to estimate key physical properties in Ti-6Al-4V additive manufacturing. • Reduces reliance on costly physical experiments by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques. • Introduces two dimensionless parameters ( Π 1 and Π 2 ) to enhance predictive accuracy beyond standard process inputs. • Compares performance of eight models (statistical and machine learning) on a curated dataset with both conventional and novel features. • Demonstrates that model and feature selection are critical for optimizing metal AM processes.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注Ti-6Al-4V增材制造样品物理性能的机器学习预测，虽未直接涉及力学与疲劳性能，但预测方法和模型可迁移至力学性能研究。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not characterize or model mechanical/fatigue properties (tensile, yield, fatigue life) of Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on predicting surface roughness, relative density, and hardness via machine learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过机器学习预测Ti-6Al-4V增材制造样品的物理性质，以减少实验成本。
summary_zh.method: 比较八种监督学习模型，结合传统与无量纲参数预测粗糙度、密度和硬度。
summary_zh.result: 模型与特征选择对预测精度至关重要，无量纲参数提升性能。
summary_zh.validation: 使用Ti-6Al-4V样品实验数据集进行模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce experimental costs by using machine learning to predict key physical properties of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Eight supervised ML models were compared using conventional and dimensionless process parameters to predict surface roughness, relative density, and hardness.
summary_en.result: Model and feature selection significantly influence prediction accuracy, with dimensionless parameters enhancing performance.
summary_en.validation: The models were validated against an experimental dataset of Ti-6Al-4V samples produced by PBF.

papers.title: Electrical transport in tunably disordered metamaterials
papers.abstract: Naturally occurring materials are often disordered, with the dependence of their bulk properties on structure being challenging to predict due to the lack of underlying crystalline axes. In this paper, we develop a digital pipeline from algorithmically created configurations with tunable disorder to 3D printed materials, as a tool to aid in the study of such materials, using electrical resistance as a test case. The designed material begins with a random point cloud that is iteratively evolved using Lloyd's algorithm to approach uniformity, with the points being connected via a Delaunay triangulation to form a disordered network metamaterial. Utilizing laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing with stainless steel 17-4 PH and titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V, we are able to experimentally measure the bulk electrical resistivity as a function of the degree of disorder in the network. The effective resistance of the structure calculated from the combinatorial weighted graph Laplacian is in good agreement with experimental data. However, the effective resistance is sensitive to anisotropy and global network topology, preventing a single network statistic or disorder characterization from predicting global resistivity.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究的是电输运性能，而非Ti-6Al-4V增材制造的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Paper focuses on electrical transport, not mechanical/fatigue performance of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发从算法生成的无序结构到3D打印材料的数字流程，研究无序对电性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用Lloyd算法和Delaunay三角剖分设计无序网络结构，通过激光粉末床熔融制造。
summary_zh.result: 加权图拉普拉斯计算的有效电阻与实验吻合，但各向异性和拓扑影响预测。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量电阻率并与计算模型对比。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a digital pipeline from algorithmically generated disordered configurations to 3D printed materials for studying the effect of tunable disorder on electrical transport.
summary_en.method: Disordered network metamaterials were designed using Lloyd's algorithm and Delaunay triangulation, then fabricated via laser powder bed fusion using stainless steel 17-4 PH and Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The effective resistance calculated from the combinatorial weighted graph Laplacian showed good agreement with experimental data, but the resistance is sensitive to anisotropy and global network topology.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of bulk electrical resistivity were compared with calculations from the weighted graph Laplacian model.

papers.title: Study of the structure and properties of a workpiece made of Ti-6Al-4V alloy obtained by hot isostatic pressing
papers.abstract: One of the promising and widespread methods of powder metallurgy is hot isostatic pressing (HIP), which makes it possible to obtain dense, non-porous workpiece from metal powders with enhanced mechanical characteristics. However, due to the uneven distribution of temperature and pressure during the casting process, an inhomogeneous structure is formed from the periphery to the center of the workpiece, which negatively affects the further operation of the finished product. The paper presents the results of a study of the structure and properties of a blank made of Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy obtained by the HIP method. Metallographic analysis was performed, and the distribution of microhardness, density, and porosity over the sample section was analyzed. It is established that the structure of the material formed during the HIP process is heterogeneous, and its properties change from the periphery to the center (microhardness and porosity increase, density decreases). It is shown that the reason for the uneven formation of mechanical properties is the presence of a gradient in the volume fraction of the β-phase, while its content in the material of the peripheral part of the workpiece is ~20%, and in the central part — 28%. The results obtained can be applied in assessing the quality of the obtained HIP workpieces made of Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy, as well as to create computational models of HIP technological processes.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究热等静压（HIP）制备的Ti-6Al-4V工件，但未涉及增材制造（AM）Ti-6Al-4V的后处理，与用户关注点不符。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not involve additive manufacturing (AM) Ti-6Al-4V; HIP is used as a primary consolidation method, not as a post-processing step for AM parts.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热等静压Ti-6Al-4V坯料的微观结构与性能不均匀性。
summary_zh.method: 通过金相分析、显微硬度、密度和孔隙率测量，表征从边缘到中心的梯度变化。
summary_zh.result: 发现β相含量从边缘20%增至中心28%，导致显微硬度和孔隙率增加、密度降低。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量与显微组织观察验证了性能梯度与β相分布的相关性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the heterogeneous structure and property distribution in Ti-6Al-4V workpieces fabricated by hot isostatic pressing.
summary_en.method: Metallographic analysis, microhardness testing, density and porosity measurements were performed across the sample cross-section.
summary_en.result: A gradient in β-phase volume fraction from ~20% at the periphery to ~28% at the center was found, correlating with increased microhardness and porosity and decreased density.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization confirmed the structure-property gradient, linking mechanical heterogeneity to phase distribution.
